svg.title: Starbase system architecture
svg.desc: Presentation tier (React 18), application tier (Express 5 REST API), data tier (MySQL 8.4 or TiDB Cloud) and an offline data pipeline that feeds the database.
svg.text: Also serves the built React bundle
run by an administrator, separate from the web request path
npm run dev starts the React development server, which proxies /api to the API on port 5000.
MySQL 8.4 runs on 127.0.0.1:3307. SQLite exists only as a test double inside server/tests.
